text: Pelza's Sluice (Japanese: , Beruza Suimon) is a location in . It is located in the Stomach of Uraya, above Yurna the Elderwood and beside Tardy Gate. It is initially full of water, but can be emptied by activating a button nearby.

The Pickling Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Secret Route. It enables the purchase of Pickled Ice Cabbages from the Sadecott Groceries shop at Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Plumber Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Cold Storage. It enables the purchase of the Plumber Escape Game from the Elgeschel Hobby Store shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Pipestraw Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Merchant Ship. It enables the purchase of Pipestraw Smoothies from the Cafe Lutino shop at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

The Pile of Letters is a Key Item in . It is needed to complete the quest Bana's Secret Treasure. It is obtained from the Treasure Trove inside Bana's chest in Bana's Bedroom in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Phosphorescent Flare is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Decimation Cannon.

Photon Slash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Halo Strike.
Pnaddio is an NPC in . He is an Indoline guard who can be found avoiding his duties on the upper level of the rooms in the Indoline Sanctum in the Indoline Praetorium.
The Platinum Music Box is a Key Item in . It is obtained from Mololo during the quest Indol's Teachings, and must be delivered to Malusio.

Pinpoint Weakness is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases the damage of Critical Hits by up to 50%. It is equivalent in effect to the Iron Headband, Ice Headband, Optical Headband, and Crimson Headband accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Picnates is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at the Theosoir Main Gate in the Kingdom of Tantal. He offers the Merc Mission Cold-Proof Crops.
Plyme is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti who can be found at the Beraf Industry Ward in the Empire of Mor Ardain. She is spoken to during Failure and Success.

Piercing Lunge is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It grants up to 100% chance for attacks to ignore enemy blocks, preventing their damage from being halved and the weapon from being deflected on contact. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
The Perfect Range Sensor is a Key Item in . They can be obtained from Cedwyn in the Gormott Province during the quest Artificial Blade Parts 2.
Phormyne is an NPC in . He is an Indoline who can be found by the Seoris Plaza West Gate in the Indoline Praetorium. He runs the Informant shop.

Pittman is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at the Goldmouth Return Port in the Argentum Trade Guild. During the party's return to Argentum, Pittman's ship was hijacked by Rhys after he absconded with Roc's Core Crystal. Rex asks Garram to borrow his ship in order to chase Rhys back to Torigoth. When they return, Rex asks him and Garram to allow the children to work as salvagers. Both men agree to take in the young workers.

Poetic License is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal, and appears after completing Failure and Success. It features a conversation between Perceval, Brighid and Perceval's Driver. Starting the Heart-to-Heart forces the time to be set to 19:00. __FORCETOC__

Pelagic Vincent (Japanese: , Umi no Vaisu) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 81 in the Merclibay Islet in the Leftherian Archipelago during Merclibay's Mightiest. It is then fought a second time along with Telluric Desirée and Celestial Bailey.

Pekt Rapchors (Japanese: , Pekku Raputa) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family that are fought at level 26 during the Challenge Battle Grazing Flock. This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Platinum Nopon Masks (Japanese: , Purachina Nopon no Kamen) are DLC accessories in . They increase the Aggro of the wearer passively by a very large amount every second. They are the upgraded version of the Nopon Mask, Metal Nopon Mask and Gold Nopon Mask accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Petal Fliers (Japanese: , Petaru Furaia) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and are fought at level 26 during the Challenge Battle Bewitching Dance. This enemy drops no items.
Phoenix Dance (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Knives. This art recycles Mòrag's Inferno Wheel.
Phaedlico is an NPC in . He is an Indoline who can be found at Goetuis Wharf #2 in the Indoline Praetorium.

Poisoned Paradise is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass, after collecting the Nopon Summons, Pt. 2 on Version 1.5.2 or later. This challenge takes place on Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. During this challenge, the party will take terrain damage from the water every 1.5 seconds.
Phantom Pivot (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when wielding Dual Swords.

The Pedestal of Stargazing (Japanese: , Hoshimi no Daiza) is a Secret Area in . It is located on a balcony that overlooks most of the Kingdom of Torna, and can be accessed from the Tornan Titan Interior. There are two Treasure Troves here. Hurricane Anise, one of the Golden Monsters, appears here after its location is purchased from the Nopon Halfsage for 700,000 G.

Peln, Pilgrim's Springland (Japanese: , Junrei Izumichi Berun) is a location in . It is a lake located south of Outrider's Forest Trail, in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. There are several Treasure Troves and an Old Machine here. The area becomes overrun with Leract Gogols during An Oasis for All.

Planus Bridge (Japanese: , Puranusu-bashi) is a location in . It is located just south of the main gate of Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna, beyond the Outrider's Forest Trail, and is guarded by Chalcedony and his brother Carnelian. There are no enemies here except during Manning the Gates.

Pischator Bridge (Japanese: , Pisukatio-bashi) is a location in . It is located in the center of Auresco, and leads up to the Median Gate from Auresco, Main Gate. Rikoko performs here, and Mireille can be found at the foot of the bridge.

Phantom Medooz (Japanese: , Fantomu Jerī) are enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family and can be found at level 40 - 42 in the Tornan Titan Interior of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly at Balaur, Dark Zone #1, Crooked Tower and Pantarhei Tower.
Pestronella Oils are Fragrance items in . They can be created by Brighid at Campsites. While in use, this pouch item will keep the Tizza Parisax in The Braying Canyon from attacking the party.
Pickled Purses are Veggie Pouch Items in . They can be crafted by Aegaeon at Campsites with 2 Shepherd's Purses , 2 Vinegar Leaves, and 1 Lucky Lettuce.
Plain Boiled Crabs are Seafood Pouch Items in . They can be crafted by Aegaeon at Campsites.
Platinum Shrooms are Vegetable collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna, in the Aletta Region near Hyber Village.
Polar Pearls are Ore collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Pestronellas are Key Items in . Three are needed for Brighid to craft Pestronella Oil.

Pinch Bunnits (Japanese: , Naguruto Banitto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 12 - 17 in the Ordia Great Plains and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott. Three must be defeated to unlock Mythra's level 2 Chroma Dust Blade Special.
Planing for the Future is a quest in . It can be received from Arb in the Sachsum Gardens in the Kingdom of Torna.

The Picker Buloofo (Japanese: , Pikkā Urusu) is a quest exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Buloofo family, and can be found at level 10 at the Secluded Boneway in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, along with three Timid Volffs, during A Simple Errand. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , it drops no items, only gold.

Pewpew is a DLC NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found in the Disused Processing Plant of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain where he must be looked for during the DLC Quest Industrial Sort of Tour.

Piper is an NPC in . He is a Tornan shopkeeper who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward of Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna. Piper offers no quests, but his Community is gained if he is spoken to after completion of A Rare Sense of Justice.
Photon Edge (Japanese: , Foton'ejji) is Mythra's Level II Blade Special in . Photon Edge is also Mythra's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Perpetual Music Box is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.

The Pillar Knoll (Japanese: , Hashira no Oka) is a landmark in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, directly above Barouh Ruins Cave, leading to Whisperwind Crossing. There is a large, rib-like structure here, and small ruined hut containing a Pororo's Favourite.
Phaedlus is a High Entia in . He can be found at Companions' Cape on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Plump Pickings (Japanese: , Mizumizushii Nogusa wo Kakuhoseyo) is a quest in . It can be received once Laennar's Worries from Laennar is accepted at Companions' Cape on Bionis' Shoulder, or later at Agni's Birthplace.
Plump Wildgrasses are five Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They must be collected in Navvir Highland for completing the quest Plump Pickings.
Peppity Herbs are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be found atop the Cragmaw Caverns on Bionis' Shoulder, and one is needed for Inclined to Climb given by Shoo-Shoo.

Perceptive Quinops (Japanese: , Enbō no Kunōpusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 74 on the hill north-east of Clear Sky Bluff, west of the lake containing Junks, on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Phlegmatic Jamir (Japanese: , Yūzen no Jamīru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 63 at Navvir Highland on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Peddlers are NPCs in . They can be found in pairs at multiple populous areas across Torna and Gormott, where they will sell Core Chips and Accessories. Peddlers are not named as, like the Nameless Wanderpon, they are not a part of the Community. Instead, they are referred to by the name of their location.

Pineapple Glasses are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Shaggy-Dog Story. They can only be worn by Riki.

Pineapple Tops are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Shaggy-Dog Story. They can only be worn by Riki.

Pineapple Gauntlets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Shaggy-Dog Story. They can only be worn by Riki.
Pointed Sleeves are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are the initial starting equipment for Melia, and can only be worn by her.
Pointed Sleeves D are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Melia.
Pointed Sleeves L are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Melia.
Perfect Storm (Japanese: ) is Finch's Level IV Blade Special in .
Phogrium is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is found in Sylvalum's South Hardheart Canyon during the course of Brotherly Love. Frye has named this new mineral after his brother Phog.
Phantom Slash (Japanese: , Fantomusurasshu) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Noah's Ouroboros arts.

Perilwing Ryuho (Japanese: , Ka tsu Tsubasa Ryuuhou; Ryuho, Wings of Disaster) is a Superboss in . It is a Unique Monster and a member of the Vollgull family and can be initially found at level 100 at Coolley Lake on Melnath's Shoulder. The Eagle Rush Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it. Through re-challenging, Perilwing Ryuho's level can be increased to a maximum at level 160. It is the only enemy in the game immune to Smash.

Perspicacious Oldar (Japanese: , Rōken no Oruda) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ardun family and can be found at level 20 at Sparres Barr in Ribbi Flats. The Horn Dance Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Pinion Primed (Japanese: , Adobansu Fezā) is a Chain Art in . It is Eunie's Chain art during a Chain Attack.
Pollux is a NPC in who can be found in Colony 9, as well as Yzana Plains.
The Pentelas Region (Japanese: , Penterasu Chihō) is a Region of Aionios in .

Petrivore Judomar (Japanese: , Iwakui Judōma) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 31 at Melnath's Pass, Upper on Melnath's Shoulder. The Accelerating Attacks Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Phantasmagorical Rist (Japanese: , Genkō no Asutarisuku) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Medooz family, and can be found at level 35 in the Cotte Trick Ruins at Great Cotte Falls. The Physical Absorber Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Phantom Streya (Japanese: , Yūhyō no Sutoreia) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Amoney family, and can be found at level 51 near the Elgares Depths Entrance in Millick Meadows. The "Mimic Technique" Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Piento Basin (Japanese: , Piento no Kubochi) is a Location in . It is located south of Menno Arch in the Eagus Wilderness.

Perrato Cave (Japanese: , Perato Dōkutsu) is a Location in . It is a cave filled with Tirkin located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region. It can be entered from Riez Tarn or Isnie Ledge and has The Lace Subterranean inside it.
Pelza's Pass (Japanese: , Beruza-tōge) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Urayan Trail in the Pentelas Region. It leads into Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region.
The Penshia Portal (Japanese: , Penshia Ganmon) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Syra Hovering Reefs in the Keves Castle Region. It leads to the Windstrong Bluffs in the High Maktha Wildwood.
The Perimeter Bridge (Japanese: , Gaikaku Higashi Renrakubashi) is a Location in . It is located at the Agnus Castle Barbican in the Cadensia Region. It connects to the Levnis Workyard.

The Perimeter Outlet (Japanese: , Gaikaku Kaihōkō) is a Landmark in . It is located by the Perimeter Woodland in Li Garte Prison Camp. A Fabricator can be added here by refurbishing the prison through Wheelideeli after completing Prison Spring Clean.
The Perimeter Woodland (Japanese: , Gaikaku Shinrin-ku) is a Location in . It is located at Li Garte Prison Camp.

Phony Temnos (Japanese: , Kyomō no Temenasu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Droid, and can be found at level 69 in the Origin Interior, in the Hangar, Upper Level. It forms the quatuor "Hollow Ones" with Artificial Optho, Vapid Roger and Dishonest Karom. The Exoshell Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

The Place of Heroes Past (Japanese: , Eirei no Iseki) is a Landmark in , located on Lavi Sandbar in Erythia Sea. It is the ruins of the Vault of Heroes from the Spirit Crucible Elpys. It becomes accessible after the party enters Origin for the first time. The walls of the vault have almost entirely crumbled away and all of the poisoned water has disappeared. The pedestal that formerly held Pneuma's Aegis Sword has also been slightly chipped. The back wall of the vault has only partly crumbled away, with Addam's crest still present. The Heroic Gulkin Unique Monster can be found here. Behind Heroic Gulkin is a "Legacy of the Seven" containing the Veneris Rings Accessory.
Pioneer's Inlet (Japanese: , Senkusha no Irie) is a Landmark in . It is located in Erythia Sea. The Cay of the Trick Grotto is located here.
Piula Path (Japanese: , Pyūra no Michi) is a location in , located on Captocorn Peak.
The Pedesto Valley Floor (Japanese: , Pedesuto Shōkoku) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Sword's Base. The Cradle Convoy Shelter is located here.
Pinasa Highland (Japanese: , Bissa no Kōdai) is a Location in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Plate Pothos are Plant Collectible items in and . They can be found in the Aetia Region in . It can also be purchased from the Colony Gamma Caravan. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found on the Aurora Shelf in .
Pointed Obsidians are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Pillowshrooms are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Plush Piranhax are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 21-22 at Sonata Saddleback in Yzana Plains and level 56-57 in Coolley Lake on Melnath's Shoulder.

Pellurid Ignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family that ride Rhinons, and can be found at level 44-45 at Visura Parkland and in Nid Cave on Elaice Highway, or at level 98-100 in Rebellion Cave in Erythia Sea.
Pentashrooms are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator or Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Poison Steels are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Pearl Snails are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Perfume Herbs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Polarizing Pips are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Plane Hoxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Hox family, and can be found at level 36-37 on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Pike Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 45 & 74 in Erythia Sea.
Peshris Fountain (Japanese: , Pesurisu no Izumi) is a Landmark in . It is located in Dannagh Desert in the Fornis Region.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Platinum Cubes are Accessories in .
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Platinum Anklets are Accessories in and . The legendary variant can be obtained from Crafty Anskey.
The Point Card is a Key Item in . It is obtained during To Face Forward. Collected Point Stickers are put on the point card.

Point Stickers are Key Items in . They are stickers for the Point Card that are obtained from Tallow in Colony Mu during To Face Forward. Up to seven stickers can be obtained, but only five are necessary to complete the quest.
Photonic Condenser is a Key Item in . It is dropped by the Mechapod Carthegia during A Burning Curiosity, Part 2.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Platinum Brooches are Accessories in and . The Silver Brooch and Gold Brooch have weaker versions of this effect. The legendary variant can be obtained from Phantom Streya. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Peacebringer Divalo.

Pikelord Tirkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 22 at the Tirkin Headquarters at Ribbi Flats, level 47 on the Urayan Trail, and level 98-100 in the Emerald Font and Demihuman Gutter in Erythia Sea.
This page lists all the quests available in the Pentelas Region.
Pixidan Pippitos are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 5 at Berje Belt in Alfeto Valley.
Polima Amoneys (Japanese: , Porima Amonē) are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Amoney family, and can be found at level 29 in Coolley Pool on Melnath's Shoulder.
Pirate Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 63-64 near Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. They ride on Merfreys.
Polka Pippitos are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 56 in Erythia Sea.

Pitapata is a NPC in . Pitapata can be found southwest of Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea. She initially appears during The Future I Want to Spin, but stays afterwards. For a payment of 10,000G, Pitapata will attempt to change the Weather to rain, but only has a chance of succeeding, just like Splishsplash.

The Planaa Ansel is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Ansel family, and is fought at level 42 alongside four Seeth Ansels at the Material Storage Warehouse on the Great Sword's Hilt during Castle Access.

Philharmonic Dust-Up is a Time Attack Challenge Battle in . It can be received from Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the second part of the Expansion Pass. Clearing this challenge with at least an A rank for the first time will unlock the Swimwear A outfit for Eunie.
Photon Storm is one of Ino's Battle Arts in . It is a variant of Refractive Edge used only by Ino.
Pirate Lariat (Japanese: , Pairētsurariatto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art exclusive to Triton. He charges energy in his right gauntlet and does a hard swipe.

Peril Punch (Japanese: , Denjarasupanchi, "Dangerous Punch") is a Battle Art in . It is an art exclusive to Triton. He hops and punches the ground sending a ground-based wave of purple energy towards enemies.

Piercing Laser is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Besieger Sheritt while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Poison Spray is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Rambler Curalie while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Pointy Stick is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Virtuous Gulkin while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Pharod is a NPC in who can be found in Fort O'Virbus in the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Platinum Shards is a Battle Art in . It is one of Masha's arts as a Hero.
Physical Defense Down or Physical Defence Down or Phys Def Down may refer to: * Phys Def Down (XC1), a Gem in * Physical Defence Down, a debuff in * Phys Def Down (XC3), a debuff in
The Pioneer's Camp (Japanese: , Kaitakusha no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located on the Aurora Shelf.
Planada Siq (Japanese: , Puranada Shīku) is a Landmark in , located in Yesterdale. It serves as the entrance into Yesterdale from the Aurora Shelf.
Pioneer's Point (Japanese: , Kaitakusha no Chōbō) is a Landmark in , located on the Aurora Shelf. It is a large Saffronia Tree above the Exile Fortress Ruins.
The Pilgrims' Rest Remains (Japanese: , Junreisha no Teiryūjo-ato) is a location in , located on the Aurora Shelf.
Photonium are Key Items in . Nine are obtained in the Sealed Cave during Ether Lift Research. They are used to construct Ether Lifts, with one piece of Photonium needed for each Ether Lift.

Perambulator Moritz (Japanese: , Junkai no Mōrittsu) is a Unique Monster in . It is an Avis type Levnis, and can be found at level 28 alongside an Agnus Vanguard and an Agnus Medic Elite at the Lumos Garrison in The Ragmos Desolation.

Peridot is an NPC in . She is a former Keves soldier who now works as part of the Liberators in Colony 9. Peridot's Community is gained when talking to her after completing Abandoned Supplies, changing Eow's Community status, and talking with her twice.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Platinum Jewels are Accessories in .
Plauss Ignas are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 22 in the Exile Fortress Ruins on the Aurora Shelf during Riku's Workshop.
The Pointy Stake is a Key Item in . It is Hekasa's Stake after it is retrieved from the Ramrod Tirkin during Hekasa's Labour at Stake. It must be returned to Hekasa.
The Photo of Glow Deinos is a Key Item in . It is a photo of a Glow Deinos that Shulk takes for Melekanze using her camera during Shoulder Survey Snaps.
The Photo of Dozy Eluca is a Key Item in . It is a photo of a Dozy Eluca that Shulk takes for Melekanze using her camera during Shoulder Survey Snaps.
Pica's Drop is a landmark in . It is located on the Ravaged Vargo in Volitaris. One of the Shackle of Samaar is located near here.
Pearl Oc-servs are enemies in . They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found in Volitaris.

Phyllistrata is a DLC NPC in . She is a Tantalese who can be found at the Theospiti Temple Ruins at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal after Corvin is awakened. Speaking to her with Corvin in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Corvin's level 4 "Light Mastery". Phyllistrata is not known to appear at any other time.
The Peerless Pairing (Japanese: ) may refer to the following; * Ethel's Ferronis * Cammuravi's Ferronis
Physical Resistance is a stat in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It displays resistance to physical-type attacks.

PianoX3 is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track 3 of disk four in the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. This track is an arrangement of another track: 46-:ri9. This song does not play in the original version of the game. In the , this song plays during Chapter 13 (Act 2), when Omomo states that she wants to stay behind on Mira.
Phoenixes are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cetos, Tornado Claw type Galdrs or black Puges.

Periperi is a Nopon in . During Chapter One, he can be found at the Goldmouth Return Port in the Argentum Trade Guild, waiting for his ship to load. During Lila's Location, he can be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain, having recently unloaded a shipment from the Gormott Province.
Pelala is an NPC in . Pelala is a Nopon who can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. Pelala runs a shop called Reedirait Bookstore specialized in Literature.

Princess Daffodils (Japanese: , Himemiresu) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they are the favourite flower of princesses of old and they are named after one.

Popipo (Japanese: , Popie) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found in Alcamoth at the fountain northeast of the Main Entrance. In Frontier Village, she can be found west of the Nopon Tower.

Ponio Hoof Seals (Japanese: , Ponio no Hizume Hanko) are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by Lampo Ponios, which can be found roaming around the Giant Mechon Debris landmark on the Fallen Arm during the day. According to their description, they are personal seals that do not require ink and they print in impractical rainbow colours. Five are required for the Colony 6 Reconstruction. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 3,900 Noponstones.

Pride Snipers (Japanese: , Buraitosunaipu, Bright Sniper) are weapons in . They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla. They can be acquired by trading with Don Argentis or Anna or Nic whom can be found in Colony 6.

Prairie Dragonflies (Japanese: , Sougentonbo) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they inhabit plains and can be aggressive when disturbed. Ababa also states that Prairie Dragonflies have around 20,000 eyes.

※ After this quest is completed, Moritz may offer another quest. See Friendship Tokens. Pride and Courage (Japanese: , Yūki to Puraido) is a quest in . It can be received from Lukas near the bridge in the southwest portion of the Residential District of Colony 9. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

Preventing Starvation (Japanese: , Gashi wo Soshi) is a quest in . It can be received from Zazadan in the Nopon Refuge in Satorl Marsh. It is the first in a series of five quests that can be received from Zazadan. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

Prism Centipedes (Japanese: , Purizumukade) are collectables in . They can be found in Central Factory and Colony 6. According to their description, they reflect sparkling light and the effect is enhanced by their 100 legs.
Prairie Caps (Japanese: , Daisōgen no Bōshi) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Prairie Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They were developed by a renowned sharpshooter from Colony 6. It is possible that this sharpshooter was Gadolt or Sharla.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Preparing for Adventure (Japanese: , Daibōken no Junbi) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Zain at Alcamoth, just north of the Fountain of Eternity. Kurralth must be spoken to first. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.
Praying Caterpiles are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 3 near Anti-Air Battery 1 and on Tephra Hill in Colony 9.
Prairie Trousers are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Pretty Bangles are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be worn by female party members.
Prairie Attire is light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be bought in shops on the Bionis' Leg.

Precipice Bridge (Japanese: , Dangai no Hashi) is a location in . It is located in Makna Forest, north of the Hode Lair and south of Glowmoss Trihenge. It is most easily reached by skip travelling to the Trihenge and walking from there. It is not a Homs or Nopon-made bridge; rather, it is a natural structure spanning an abyss. The "bridge" runs northwest to southeast. There are three Orluga in the middle of it - a Sabulum, Ammos and Arena - and a few more at either end. A Koriba Pterix periodically flies over the area.
Ponios (Japanese: , Ponio) are enemies in the . They are horse-like creatures with reptilian scales, and don't vary in appearance other than size. There are no unique or quest-exclusive Ponios.
The Popular Staff (Japanese: , Popyurāsutaffu) is a staff that can be wielded by Melia in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be purchased at the Melfica Road Shop for 13,440 Gold.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Preparing for Adventure 2 (Japanese: , Zoku: Daibōken no Junbi) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Kurralth at Alcamoth, just north of the Fountain of Eternity. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Popularity Premonition (Japanese: , Moteki Tōrai no Yokan) is a quest in . It can be received from Leku in the upper area of the Archaeology Level in Frontier Village. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.
The Prayer Room (Japanese: , Inori no Ma) is a location in . It is located in Tephra Cave, behind a hidden door behind the Sacrificial Altar in Bafalgar Tomb.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Preparing for Adventure 3 (Japanese: , Zokuzoku: Daibōken no Junbi) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Zain at Alcamoth, just north of the Fountain of Eternity. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

Pretty Flamii Legs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Flamii on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are long thin legs with lean and graceful forms. Three of them are needed for I Want to be a Homs!.

Ponio Neck Meats are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Ponios on Bionis' Leg or traded for in Colony 6 or the Refugee Camp. According to their description, they are decent meats that are high in glycogen and the best fatty meats are on the necks. Three pieces of Ponio Neck Meat are needed for A Thoughtful Idea.
Precious Retratro (Japanese: , Hōju no Retorāto) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 53 in the 3rd Fuel Supply Room of Galahad Fortress.

Generally, each party member tends to prefer a certain category of items and dislike another. While giving an unwanted gift may lower the affinity between two characters, any acquired skill-link levels will be retained (i.e. if the affinity level drops from Pink Heart to Purple Flower, the fifth skill-link level is still available).

Prom Skeeters (Japanese: , Puromu Sukīto) are enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found along the Tephra Path leading to the Caterpile Nest in Tephra Cave. They can drop Black Nectar, which is required for Education-Minded Suzanna.
Prairie Antols (Japanese: , Pureirī Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 16 on Bionis' Leg near Daksha Shrine.

Possessio Hodes (Japanese: , Poseshio Fūdi) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hode family, and can be found at level 36 at the Eryth Sea. They drop Luxury Hode Wood, three pieces of which are needed for the quest Mend the Plant.

The Primordial Telethia (Japanese: , Seiseki no Tereshia) is a quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Phoenix-type member of the Telethia family, and it appears at level 87 in Alcamoth at the room entrance of the Ether Furnace Controls, only during the quest Broken Ether Furnace 2. The Primordial Telethia must be defeated in order to complete the quest.

__FORCETOC__ Primo Novae (Japanese: , Purimo Nova) are story exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 72 in Bionis' Interior only during the boss battle with Lorithia occurring into Bionis' heart. Although they do not respawn, several of them may be summoned during the course of the battle.
Precision Cores are materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by the Mischievious Naberius at Sword Valley, or can be traded for.

Potent Brog Poisons are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Poison Brogs in Satorl Marsh. Potent Brog Poisons are also available via trading with Gowago if he moves to Colony 6. According to their description, people say they are fast-acting poisons, but that is a complete fabrication. Two lots of Potent Brog Poison are needed for Secret Elixir Ingredients.

Presents for Priceless Pupils (Japanese: , Daijina Deshi) is a quest in . It can be received from Dobadoba in Frontier Village after completing Safer Energy or Distilling Active Ingredients. He can be mainly found at the Pollen Orb Storehouse. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment.
The Port Maintenance Bay (Japanese: , Kishinkō Seibijō) is a location in . It is located in the furthest south point of Sword Valley. A Wind Ether Gear can be found here, as well as the Fate Labolas.

The Port Access Pathway (Japanese: , Kishinkō: Renrakutsūro) is a location in . It is located in Sword Valley, south west of the Enalda Control Base and east of the Heavy Machine Depot. It is a square room, reachable from either of the previously mentioned locations, containing few enemies.

The Preparation Bay (Japanese: , Seibi Junbishitsu) is a landmark in . It is located on the second basement floor of Galahad Fortress, west of the Ether Blast Furnace. There is nothing here other than a lift down to the Face Maintenance Bay.

The Port Terminal (Japanese: , Kishin-kō Tāminaru) is a landmark in . It is located on the ground floor of the Central Factory. It is the first landmark encountered in the factory. In the , there is a Time Attack Portal here.
The Prone (Japanese: , Baiasu, Vyers; English dub: ) are a race of beings in . They are a warlike alien race hailing from Tormein, ordered to exterminate humanity as a part of the Ganglion alliance.

Potamuses (English dub: ) (Japanese: , Hippo) are gentle enemies in dwelling close to watering holes. They are hippopotamus-like creatures. Due to their nomadic lifestyle, the Nopon of Mira make extensive use of the local Potamuses (which they call Nopopotamuses) as tamed beasts of burden, making them transport their cargo and tents and a common sight near the various caravans. They are even able to reside within the Nopopotamus's own stomach during travel, the animal having been trained to spit out its Nopon master on demand.

Prologue A (プロローグ A) is an Event Track in Xenoblade Chronicles, composed and arranged by Yoko Shimomura, with additional arrangement by Tsutomu Narita. It is track 2 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music plays in the game's very first cutscenes, during the Battle of Sword Valley as Dunban, Dickson, and Mumkhar regroup to meet the Mechon onslaught, prior to the game's first tutorial battles.

Prologue B (プロローグ B) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Yoko Shimomura, with additional arrangement by Tsutomu Narita. It is track 3 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track three of disc one from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is a heightened version of Prologue A and plays during the cutscenes immediately following the tutorial sequence at the Battle of Sword Valley as Dunban makes a final charge against the Mechon, followed by the camera panning out from the Bionis and Mechonis leading into the title call. Notably, it plays at one other point, much later in the game, when Shulk

Prairie Lepyxes (Japanese: , Purērī Fontera) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lepyx family, and can be found at level 13-19 at FN Site 117 or on West Janpath Plain in Primordia.

The Potter's Rock (Japanese: , Rokuroiwa) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a spiralling plant-like rock located in Noctilum, in the middle of Rustpool Banks. It is the first landmark near the entrance from Primordia.

Project X Zone 2 is the second installment in the Project X Zone series. The game is titled as Project X Zone 2: Brave New World (Japanese: , Purojekuto Kurosu Zōn 2: Bureibu Nyū Wārudo) in Japan. It was developed by Monolith Soft, and produced and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Fiora has been introduced as a playable character, alongside other content such as areas and an enemy being represented in the game. Fiora was also one of the first three Nintendo characters to have been introduced in the game.

Porter Puges (Japanese: , Pōtā Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 13-14 in Cauldros, north of FN Site 502. Three must be defeated for the basic mission Pounding Puges.
Progen (Japanese: , Ekuusu, lit. Equus) are large horse-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They could be considered counterparts of the Monoceros. They can be found in Sylvalum and Noctilum.
Pond Terebras (Japanese: , Pondo Rutoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Terebra family. They can be found at level 17-19 in Noctilum stream north-east of FN Site 205.

Proficiency Exam 1 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 1) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 2 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 2) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 3 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 3) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 4 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 4) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 5 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 5) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. Proficiency Exam 6 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 6) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 7 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 7) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Proficiency Exam 8 (Japanese: , Raisensu Nintei Shiken 8) is a Normal Mission in . It is received with The Skell License from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks. This is one of eight missions that must be completed in order to receive the Skell License Certificates needed to obtain a Skell License.

Primal Apricas (Japanese: , Puraimaru Dometomu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aprica family, and can be found at level 48-50 near FN Site 317 in Oblivia. They can drop the Redwood Aprica Antlers needed for Mayhem.

The Predator Falsaxum (Japanese: , Puredetā Garukasu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Falsaxum, and can be found at level 23 at Barbarich Desert in Oblivia during A Grim Undertaking. After laying the bait, the party is attacked by it, but the mission does not require it to be defeated.
The Primordia Collectopedia is a portion of the Collectopedia in Xenoblade Chronicles X.

Prone Bullies (Japanese: , Baiasu Tafugai, Prone Tough Guy) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 41-50 at Lakeview Stronghold or Waterway Tangle in Noctilum.

The Port Side (Japanese: , Sagen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Ma-non Ship of New Los Angeles. The door that leads there is initially closed, but it will be opened after Prone Sweet Prone is completed.
Powell is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District in New Los Angeles during the day.

The Prog Ares (English dub: , Japanese: , Purogu Aresu) is a Main Boss in . It is a Human-Made Skell fought at level 45 in the Ganglion Weapons Hangar in Cauldros during Chapter 11. It is piloted by Lao. Following its defeat, the Prog Ares can be re-battled in the Time Attack Mission The Expert Warrior.

Prankster Mephites (Japanese: , Puranku Mepitesu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 41-44 at Gehenna Span and near Delusians South Summit in Sylvalum.

Prinsipe, the Ravenous (Japanese: , Donshoku no Puransu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 44 at a Forgotten Mining Frigate above Adder Byroad in Cauldros at nightime. A Marnuck Gatling trooper watches over it. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Prinsipe, the Ravenous.
Prapayas (Japanese: , Furappaiya) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.

Popote (Japanese: , Potepote) is an NPC in . He is a Nopon and can be found at the Drongo Caravan in Cauldros. After completing Sparking a Smile with A route chosen, he can be found later at the Nopon Bazaar in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

Primitive Colossus Statues (Japanese: , Genshi no Kyoshinzō) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular at the Divine Roost and near Everwhelm Falls.
Pomio Spores (Japanese: , Pōmio no Hōshi) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Poron Tulips (Japanese: , Poron Chūrippu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular at FN Site 503 and around the White Phosphor Lake. Six of them are needed for the Normal Mission The Big Bang.
Prickly Crickets (Japanese: , Kirikirigirisu) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular around the Infernal Ledges.
Prone Coin Purses are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Prone in Primordia.
Potamus Life Lungs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Potamuses.
Pristine Pincers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Forfexes in Noctilum.

Professor B (Japanese: , Dokutā B) is an NPC in . He is located in the Industrial District where he works with his assistant Veven, and claims to be from the future. He gives his name as "B°&7k%±|" but tells everyone to address him as Professor B. The affinity chart gives his race as "B********", which he suggests may be the end result of millions of years of human evolution. He is the CEO of the Factory 1.21 Arms Manufacturer.

Professor B's Lab (Japanese: , Dokutā B no Kenkyūjo) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the laboratory of Professor B, located in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. This landmark is unlocked during Mystery Man, the first mission involving Professor B.
Pristine Spicules are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Duoguills in Primordia or Oblivia, or from Scintimures.
Pristine Insect Legs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Scirpos.

Promethium Petramands (Japanese: , Puromechiumu Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 56-58 in Stonelattice Cavern in Primordia.

Praseodymium Petramands (Japanese: , Puraseojimu Aranea) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 26-30 in Cauldros, within the Old Ceremonial Hollow. They can drop the Black Petramand Silk needed for The Next Big Thing. They can drop all armor pieces in Sakuraba Industries' Vivid Skell Wear series (Advanced), or rarely Valor (Worn).
Poppy, the Pyromaniac (Japanese: , Sakuyaku no Popī) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Visigel family. It can be found at level 36 inside the Infernal Ledges in Cauldros.
Prisoner Saltats (Japanese: , Purizunā Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 15-17 at Primeval Meadow in Oblivia.

Prometheus Petramands (Japanese: , Puromechi Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family, and can be found at level 38-40 on a ridge southwest of FN Site 318 in Oblivia.

Prairie Blattas (Japanese: , Purērī Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 41-50 on top of a pillar south of FN Site 211 in Noctilum during the night.
Prone Admirals (Japanese: , Baiasu Adomiraru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 51 in Oblivia, near FN Site 307.
Prone Barbarians (Japanese: , Baiasu Barubarosu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 11-20 in Oblivia's Mesa Fortress.
Prone Berserkers (Japanese: , Baiasu Bāsākā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 41-50 in Primordia, near FN Site 119.
Prone Commanders (Japanese: , Baiasu Komandā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 at Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Condemneds (Japanese: , Baiasu Damudo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 11-20 at Mesa Fortress in Oblivia.
Progen Hoof Seals are rare materials in . They can be dropped by the Progen in Primordia.

Professor B's Return (Japanese: , Dokutā B no Kikan) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Veven at Professor B's Lab in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. Upon completion of this mission, the arms manufacturer Factory 1.21 is unlocked. Although not required to accept this mission, the Basic Mission Rendezvous at the Lab! can be used to locate this mission.
Prea Slarth is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone who can be found at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the night.

Predator and Prey (Japanese: , Hantingu) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Dirk at West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum. Completing Predator and Prey also awards the achievement This Cruel World.
Primordian Cavern Crawl is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a geologist and the primary destination is Primordia.
Potential Up is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It increases the Potential of a party member by a fixed amount. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.PTL.
Potential Boost is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It increases the potential stat of a party member by a fixed percentage.
Pounding Puges is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

Promises Made is Gwin's second Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs at late night by the construction barricades southwest of the Sports Complex in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Gwin and Cross.
Popo is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the day after Castle in the Sky is completed.

Professorial (Japanese: , Dokutā B Shissō Jiken, The Disappearance of Doctor B) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Veven outside the Industrial District's Outfitters Test Hangar, behind the large crates on the south side of the entrance.
Pristine Whiskers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims.
The Practice Data Probe is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from Kirsty during Wrothian Innovation.
Popular Peppers is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a restaurant owner and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Preparations for War is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Prone to obtain Warbones in Oblivia.

Prone Boxes (Japanese: , Baiasu Bokusu) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 30 at Sapphire Table in Noctilum. They must be defeated during The King of Fear. They drop no treasure.
Preacher Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Bozé and Cross during the morning.

Pristine Bristles are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Sphinxes, including the Tainted Sphinx, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They can also be earned by completing the Time Attack Mission The Infernal Beast. They are components in X, XV, and XX Melee Attack Drive augments.

Pristine Claws are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Scirpos, or for 36 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Side Attack Plus and PositionDmg.SIDE augments, and level 20 Archetype weapons.

Pristine Dorsal Fins are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Diluses, or for 72 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components of Reflect Damage Up V augments.

Pristine Insect Jaws are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Ictuses and Vivohasts, or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Arts: Recover HP and all Crush: Gain TP and Crush.GP augments.

Prime Tank Tops are casual torso Armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats; however, the camo variants sell for 120 Credits instead of the usual 75 Credits.
